about: The introitus of the formulary “Palm Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, do not remove Your help far from me; look to my defense. Deliver me from the lion’s mouth, and my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns. O God, my God, look upon me; why have You forsaken me? Far from my salvation are the words of my sins. O Lord, do not remove Your help far from me; look to my defense. Deliver me from the lion’s mouth, and my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns.
